name: Morecambe Bay L.V.

findlay1887.name: MORECAMBE BAY LT.-V.
findlay1887.character: One rev. red lt., ½ min.
findlay1887.description: In 12 fathoms, 14¾ miles W. by S. from Walney lighthouse. Red ball at mast-head

report1880: revolving red light, flash every 30 seconds

findlay1887.name: River Dee Lightvessel
findlay1887.description: In 8 fathoms, at river entrance, 7½ miles within the bar

name: Point of Ayr (Flintshire)

findlay1879.name: AIR POINT
findlay1879.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
findlay1879.description: On old lighthouse, with red and white bands. It is red only within Hoyle Sand, from N.W. to E. by S. ¼ S.; fog-bell

findlay1879.name: Menai, Trwyn-Du Point

findlay1887.name: MENAI, TRWYN-DU PT.
findlay1887.description: Tower, 96 ft. high, painted in black and white bands

findlay1879.name: SKERRIES
findlay1879.character: One bright fixed light Lower red light
findlay1879.description: Upper lt. not visible over East Platters Rock, from S.S.E. to S.E. ½ S. Red lt. over Ethel and Coal Rocks, from E. ½ S. to E. by N. ½ N. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 3 minutes

findlay1887.name: SKERRIES
findlay1887.character: One occulting bright lt., 1 min. Lower fixed red light
findlay1887.description: White tower, 75 ft. high. Upper lt. eclipsed 3 times in quick succession, followed by 50 secs. light; not visible over East Platters Rock, from S.S.E. to S.E. ½ S. Low red light shown over Ethel and Coal Rocks, from E. ½ S. to E. by N. ½ N.

edwards1884.name: Skerries--2 lights
edwards1884.character: White, fixed Red sector from lower window

name: Holyhead Breakwater

findlay1879.name: Holyhead
findlay1879.character: 1. One red flash. lt. 7½ s. 2. One bright fixed lt. 3. One small red light 4. Red and green lights
findlay1879.description: 1. Lighthouse on new breakwater. Fog Bell 3 times every 15 secs. Fog Horns for mail packets at 11 a.m. and 11.30 p.m. 2. On end of wooden jetty; old harbour Bell. 3. On old tower, to N.E., shown from N.E. to N.N.E. ½ E. to clear Platters. Fog Bell 4. Red lt. on starboard; green lt. on port side of inner harbour

findlay1887.name: Holyhead
findlay1887.character: 1. One flash. red lt., 7½ s. 2. One fixed bright lt. 3. One small red light 4. Fix. red and green lts.
findlay1887.description: 1. Lighthouse on breakwater. Fixed lt. visible between flashes, within 3 or 4 miles. 2. On end of wooden jetty; old harbour 3. On old pier-head; shown from N.E. ½ N. to N.E. by N. ½ N., to clear Platters, &c. 4. Red light on North side, green light on South side, of inner harbour

report1880: Red; flashes every 7-1/2 seconds; visible 13 miles. Appears as a fixed red light at a distance of 3 or 4 miles

name: North Stack
report1880: small white light revolving in 1-1/2 min., occasionally shown 40 feet above sea and 30 yards N. of S. Stack L.H.

findlay1879.name: SOUTH STACK ROCK
findlay1879.description: White tower, 84 ft. During fogs, a smaller br. revol. lt., at 40 ft., is shown at 30 yds. N. of lt.-ho. A Fog-bell once ev. 15 secs.; also Gun (experimental, with holophone mouthpiece) fired ev. 10 min. from North Stack

findlay1887.name: SOUTH STACK ROCK
findlay1887.description: White tower, 84 ft. high. During fogs a smaller bright revolving light, 1 minute, at 90 ft., is shown at 65 yards W. by S. of lighthouse, between S. ½ W. and N.E. ¾ E. (In partial fogs the two revolving lights may appear as one irregular light)

name: Caernarfon Bay L.V.

findlay1879.name: CAERNARVON BAY LT.-VESSEL
findlay1879.description: In 30 fathoms, at 12½ miles S.S.W. ¾ W. of South Stack light-ho. Flashes bright, bright and red. A small ball over large one. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 2 minutes

findlay1887.name: CARNARVON BAY LT.-V.
findlay1887.description: In 30 fathoms, at 12¾ miles S.W. by S. ½ S. from South Stack lt.-ho. Flashes bright, bright, and red. Red, with small ball over large one

edwards1884.name: Carnarvon Bay light vessel
edwards1884.character: White and red, revolving, 20 seconds interval ; twice white, once red

report1880: revolving with white and red flashes at intervals of 20 seconds, in order of two white and one red; visible 10 miles

name: St Tudwal's

findlay1879.name: St. Tudwall Roads
findlay1879.character: 1. One br. and red lt. 2. One lower red lt.
findlay1879.description: 1. Vis. 8 secs., obscured 2 secs. White to westward betw. N. by E. and S. by W. Red from S. by W. to S.E. White from S.E. to N.E. by E. ½ E., and thence red to N. by E. Obscured by East Island, betw. N.E. ½ E. and E. by N. ½ N. 2. A ray with an arc of 15° is shown over Carreg-y-trai, from E. by S. to E. ½ N., from window 16 ft. below main light

findlay1887.name: ST. TUDWALL ROADS
findlay1887.character: 1. One occulting bright or red light 2. One lower fix. red lt.
findlay1887.description: 1. White tower, 35 feet high, on West island. Light vis. 8 secs., eclipsed 2 secs.; bright to westward betw. N. by E. and S. by W.; thence red to S.E.; thence br. to N.E. by E. ½ E., and thence red to N. by E. Obscured by East Island betw. N.E. ½ E. & E. by N. ½ N. 2. A red ray, with an arc of 15°, is shown over Carreg-y-trai, from E. by S. to E. ½ N., from window 16 ft. below main light

edwards1884.name: St. Tudwall
edwards1884.character: Red and white sectors, occulting, bright 8 seconds, eclipsed 2 seconds Red, fixed, in same tower

report1880: occulting, light of 8 seconds duration, followed by eclipse of 2 seconds, white and red; also a fixed red light (not occulting) from a window 16 feet below the high light

findlay1879.name: BARDSEY ISLAND
findlay1879.description: A square white tower, 99 ft. high. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 5 minutes

findlay1887.name: BARDSEY ISLAND
findlay1887.character: One occult. br. lt., ½ min.
findlay1887.description: A square white tower, 99 feet high. Light eclipsed for 3 secs. once in every ½ minute...

name: Cardigan Bay L.V.

findlay1879.name: CARDIGAN BAY LT.-V.
findlay1879.description: In 35 fathoms, at 20 miles northward from Port Cardigan Gong

findlay1887.name: CARDIGAN BAY LT.-V.
findlay1887.character: One rev. red lt., ½ min.
findlay1887.description: In 35 fathoms, at 20 miles N. by W. from Port Cardigan

report1880: Red; revolving every 30 seconds; visible 10 miles going in

findlay1879.name: SOUTH BISHOP ROCK

findlay1887.name: SOUTH BISHOP ROCK
findlay1887.description: White tower, 36 ft. high

findlay1879.name: SMALLS
findlay1879.description: Granite tower, 141 ft., red & white bands. Lt. bright seaward, from E. ½ S. to S.E. ½ E. The lt. is red over Hats and Barrels Rocks. Bell sounded, and rockets to explode sent up ev. half hour in fogs.

findlay1887.name: SMALLS
findlay1887.character: One occulting bright or red light, 1 min.
findlay1887.description: Granite tower, 141 ft. high, red & white bands. Light eclipsed twice in quick succession, followed by 54 secs. light; bright seaward; red over Hats and Barrels Rocks between E. ½ S. and S.E. ¾ E.

findlay1879.name: Great Castle Head

findlay1879.name: ST. ANN'S POINT
findlay1879.description: White towers, 75 and 42 ft., 610 ft. apart, on W. side. In one N. by W. ½ W., lead in clear of Crow and Toes Rocks. A red ray from high lighthouse shows over Chapel and Harbour Rocks to between S.E. ½ S. and E. ½ S. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 3 minutes

findlay1887.name: MILFORD HAVEN ST. ANN'S POINT
findlay1887.description: White towers, 75 and 42 ft. high, 610 ft. apart, on W. side. In line, N.N.W., lead in clear of Crow and Toes Rocks. A red ray from high lighthouse shows over Chapel and Harbour Rocks between S.E. and East.

findlay1879.name: ST. ANN'S POINT
findlay1879.description: White towers, 75 and 42 ft., 610 ft. apart, on W. side. In one N. by W. ½ W., lead in clear of Crow and Toes Rocks. A red ray from high lighthouse shows over Chapel and Harbour Rocks to between S.E. ½ S. and E. ½ S. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 3 minutes

findlay1887.name: MILFORD HAVEN ST. ANN'S POINT
findlay1887.description: White towers, 75 and 42 ft. high, 610 ft. apart, on W. side. In line, N.N.W., lead in clear of Crow and Toes Rocks. A red ray from high lighthouse shows over Chapel and Harbour Rocks between S.E. and East.

findlay1879.name: ST. ANN'S POINT
findlay1879.description: White towers, 75 and 42 ft., 610 ft. apart, on W. side. In one N. by W. ½ W., lead in clear of Crow and Toes Rocks. A red ray from high lighthouse shows over Chapel and Harbour Rocks to between S.E. ½ S. and E. ½ S. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 3 minutes

findlay1887.name: MILFORD HAVEN ST. ANN'S POINT
findlay1887.description: White towers, 75 and 42 ft. high, 610 ft. apart, on W. side. In line, N.N.W., lead in clear of Crow and Toes Rocks. A red ray from high lighthouse shows over Chapel and Harbour Rocks between S.E. and East.

name: Caldey

findlay1879.name: CALDY ISLAND
findlay1879.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
findlay1879.description: The lt. is bright seaward, but is red toward Old Castle Head, from N. 70° W. to N. 56° W., and is red over Woolhouse Shoal from N. 55° E. to N. 15° E.

findlay1887.name: CALDY ISLAND
findlay1887.character: One occulting bright or red light, ½ min.
findlay1887.description: White tower, 52 ft. high, on S. part of island. Light eclipsed for 3 secs., once in every ½ minute; bright seaward; red towards Old Castle Head, from W. by N. ¾ N. to N.W. by W., and over Woolhouse Shoal from N. by E. ½ E. to N.E. ¾ E.

report1880: Fixed; visible 20 miles; bright to seaward, red in direction of Old Castle Head and Woolhouse Shoal

findlay1879.name: Helwick Lightvessel
findlay1879.description: In 16½ fathoms, off W. end of Sand. Fog-horn 5 secs. ev. 2 min. Warning-gun

findlay1887.description: In 18 fathoms, 2 miles N.W. by W. ¾ W. from One-fathom Bank buoy. Red, with ball ...

report1880: Flashing every 15 seconds; 38 feet above sea; fixed red light at a lower elevation

findlay1887.character: One occult. br. or red lt.
findlay1887.description: White tower, 99 ft. high, on South point. Lt. eclipsed 3 secs. twice in ev. ½ min.; red betw. N.W. ¾ W. and N. by W. ½ W.; thence bright to N. ½ W., from Ranie Spit Shoal to West Cardiff buoy; and thence red to N.E.

edwards1884.name: Flatholm
edwards1884.character: White, with red sector, occulting half-minute

edwards1884.name: English and Welsh Grounds light vessel

name: West Usk

findlay1879.name: Usk, Newport
findlay1879.description: West side. Light bright in channel, red over Welsh Grounds and Welsh Hook; bright North to land; bright up river

findlay1887.name: Usk (Newport)
findlay1887.character: One fixed bright, red, or green light
findlay1887.description: White tower, 57 ft. high, on West side. Light bright betw. S.W. by W. ¾ W. and S.S.W.; thence red to S. by E. ½ E.; thence bright over river entrance to S.E. by S. ½ S.; thence red to the land. Green up the river between E. by N. ½ N. and N.E. by E. ½ E.........

edwards1884.name: Usk
edwards1884.character: Red, white, and green sectors, fixed

report1880: Fixed; visible 11 miles; white and red

findlay1887.name: Avon
findlay1887.character: One occulting br., red, or green lt., ½ min.

edwards1884.name: Avon
edwards1884.character: White, with red and green sectors, occulting half-minute

name: Burnham

findlay1879.name: Burnham, or Bridgewater
findlay1879.character: Up. lt. intermit. 4 min. Lower light fixed
findlay1879.description: In one, E. by S. ½ S., 1,500 ft. apart. Low lt. bright, visible westward from W. by N. to N.W. by W. ¾ W.; a red lt. from low tower shows over the bar from W. by N. to W. ½ N.; and a red lt. up the river from S. by W. to S. by W. ½ W.

findlay1887.name: Burnham, or Bridgewater
findlay1887.character: Upper light occulting bright, 1 min. Lower light fixed bright or red
findlay1887.description: On East side of entrance to River. In one, E. by S. ½ S., 1,500 ft. apart. High lt. eclipsed twice in quick succession, then visible for 54 secs.; white tower, 99 ft. high. Low light, square tower, 36 ft. high, with black streak; bright between W. ¾ N. and W.N.W.; red over the bar between W. by N. and W. ½ N.; and red up the river between S. by W. and S. by W. ½ W.

edwards1884.name: Burnham--2 lights
edwards1884.character: High, white, intermittent, 3½ minutes visible, half-minute dark Low, white and red, fixed

report1880: Upper intermittent; visible 15 miles. Lower, fixed; visible 9 miles

findlay1879.name: BULL POINT
findlay1879.description: Lt.-ho. to be completed during the summer of 1879, and will show triple flash. lt. ev. ½ min. A lower red fix. lt. will be shown over Morte Stone. Fog-trumpet, to give 3 blasts once every 2 minutes

findlay1887.name: BULL POINT
findlay1887.character: One 3-flash. br. lt., ½ m., and lower fixed red lt.
findlay1887.description: White tower. Light shows three quick flashes, followed by 18 secs. darkness, every ½ min. Red light, 18 ft. lower, shows betw. W. by S. and N.W. by W. ½ W., to mark Morte Stone

edwards1884.name: Bull Point
edwards1884.character: White, group flashing, 3 flashes every half-minute Red, fixed, in same tower

name: Bideford Bar (Instow)

findlay1879.name: Bideford
findlay1879.description: On Braunton Sands, North side of entrance. In one, S.E. ¼ S., lead over bar; from half flood to half ebb

findlay1887.name: BIDEFORD
findlay1887.description: White towers, 311 yards apart, on Braunton Sands, N. side of entrance. In one, S.E. ½ E., lead over bar. High light vis. betw. W.S.W. and N.N.W.; obscured betw. N.N.W. and E. ½ N., over Baggy Leap and Asp Rks.; a lt. of less power vis. in harb. from E. ½ N., through South, to W.S.W. Low lt. only shown from half-flood to half-ebb, while 15 ft. over bar; appears full between West and N.W. by N. ½ N.

report1880: Low light visible from half-flood to half-ebb, 14 and 11 miles

name: Lundy

findlay1879.name: LUNDY ISLAND
findlay1879.character: Upper lt., rev. ev. 2 m. Lower fixed light
findlay1879.description: In one tower, 96 ft. high. Low light visible to W. between N.N.W. and W.S.W. Rocket every 10 min. in fogs

findlay1887.name: LUNDY ISLAND

findlay1887.description: In one white tower, 96 feet high, half a mile from South end of island. Low light visible to West between N. by W. and S.W.

edwards1884.name: Lundy Island--2 lights
edwards1884.character: Upper, white, revolving, 2 minutes interval Lower, white, fixed

report1880: Upper visible 30 miles, revolving every 2 minutes. Low light fixed, only visible between bearings of S. by E. and N.E.

name: Hartland Point

findlay1879.name: HARTLAND POINT
findlay1879.description: New tower, showing at intervals of 30 secs. two bright and one red flash. Fog-Horn 5 secs. in every 2 min.

findlay1887.name: HARTLAND POINT
findlay1887.description: White tower, showing one flash at intervals of 30 secs., two bright and one red

edwards1884.name: Hartland Point
edwards1884.character: White and red, revolving, half-minute interval

report1880: revolving, 30 seconds, two white and one red

findlay1879.name: TREVOSE HEAD

findlay1887.name: TREVOSE HEAD
findlay1887.description: White tower, 87 ft. high, on N.W. extremity. Light eclipsed 3 times in quick succession in 15 secs., and then visible for 45 secs.

edwards1884.name: Trevose Head
edwards1884.character: White, occulting, three occultations every minute

name: Godrevy

findlay1879.name: GODREVY
findlay1879.character: One br. flash. lt., 10 secs. Lower red light
findlay1879.description: On the island. A bell in fogs. Lower red lt. to N.W. over the Stones Rocks, between N.W. and N. by W.

findlay1887.name: GODREVY
findlay1887.character: One flash. br. lt., 10 secs. Lower fixed red light
findlay1887.description: Stone tower, 86 ft. high, on the island. Lower red light shown over Stones Rocks, between N.W. and N. by W.

edwards1884.name: Godrevy--2 lights
edwards1884.character: White, flashing, 10 seconds Red, fixed, in same tower

report1880: Flashing every 10 seconds; visible 15 miles. A fixed red light in same tower, 27 feet below flashing light; visible from S. by E. to S.E.

findlay1887.name: LONGSHIPS

edwards1884.name: Longship's Rock, Land's End

findlay1887.name: FALMOUTH
findlay1887.character: 1. One rev. br. lt., 20 s., and lower fixed br. lt. 2. Two fixed green lts.
findlay1887.description: 1. White lt.-ho., 62 ft. high, on St. Anthony Point. The lower lt. shows betw. S.W. by S. ½ S. and S. by W., to clear Manacle Rocks 2. On ends of breakwaters

edwards1884.name: Falmouth, St. Anthony's Point
edwards1884.character: White, revolving, 20 seconds interval; white, fixed, in same tower

findlay1879.name: EDDYSTONE
findlay1879.description: An admirable stone tower, with red and white bands, 89 ft. above foundation on the rock, which covers 14 ft. at high water. Fog-bell, 5 strokes once in every ½ minute

findlay1887.name: EDDYSTONE
findlay1887.character: One 2-flashing br. lt., ½ min., & low fix. br. lt.
findlay1887.description: New granite lt.-ho., 168 ft. high, S. by E. ¾ E. from old tower. Two quick flashes in every ½ min. A lower fix. br. lt. shown over Hand Deeps, betw. N.W. by N. ½ N. and N.W. ¾ W.

edwards1884.name: Eddystone--2 lights
edwards1884.character: White, group flashing, two flashes every half-minute; white, fixed, in same tower

findlay1879.name: Plymouth Breakwater
findlay1879.character: One bright or red light Lower bright light
findlay1879.description: On W. end; red to seaward, but br. E. of N.E. ½ E. from it. A lower br. lt. is seen when the channel is open. A bell during fogs ...

findlay1887.name: Plymouth Breakwater
findlay1887.character: One occulting bright or red light, ½ min. Lower fixed bright light
findlay1887.description: Granite tower, 76 ft. high, on W. end. Light eclipsed 3 secs. every ½ min.; bright seaward, betw. E. by S. ½ S. and N.E. ½ E., through South, and red over the anchorage. A lower bright light is seen when channel is open, between S.W. ¾ W. and S.W. by W. ¾ W.

edwards1884.name: Plymouth Breakwater
edwards1884.character: White to seaward, red over anchorage, occulting, half-minute interval; white, fixed, in same tower

findlay1879.name: START POINT
findlay1879.character: One brilliant revol. lt., visible every minute
findlay1879.description: A white tower, 92 ft. high. A fix. lt. at 181 ft. is also vis. from tower over Skerries Rocks betw. N.E. ¾ E. and E. ½ N. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 3 minutes

findlay1887.name: START POINT
findlay1887.character: One rev. br. lt., 1 min., and fixed bright light
findlay1887.description: White tower, 92 feet high. A fixed light at 181 ft. is shown over Skerries Rocks between N.E. ¾ E. and E. ½ S. Signal Station to S.

edwards1884.name: Start Point
edwards1884.character: White, revolving, one minute interval; white, fixed, in same tower

findlay1879.name: PORTLAND
findlay1879.character: High lt., br. and fixed Low lt., br. and fixed
findlay1879.description: White towers, 50 & 85 ft. high, 1,509 ft. apart, near the Bill. In one, N.W. by N., lead betw. Race and Shambles. Low lt. only shown between N.W. by N. ¾ N. and E.S.E.

findlay1887.name: PORTLAND
findlay1887.description: White towers, 50 & 85 ft. high, 1,509 ft. apart, near the Bill. In one, N.W. by N., lead between Race and Shambles. Low light only shown between N.W. by W. ¾ W. and E.N.E.

findlay1879.name: Shambles Shoal Lt.-Ves.
findlay1879.description: On E. end of shoal, in 15 fms. Fog Horn, 1 blast every 2 min. Warning Gun

findlay1887.name: SHAMBLES SHL. LT.-V.
findlay1887.description: At East end of shoal, in 15 fathoms. Flash of 5 secs., eclipse 6 secs., flash 1½ sec., eclipse 17½ secs. Red, with ball

edwards1884.name: Shambles light vessel
edwards1884.character: White, group flashing, 2 flashes every half-minute

findlay1887.name: DURLSTON HEAD
findlay1887.description: White lighthouse, 39 ft. high, on Anvil Point, West part of head. A flash every 10 secs., visible between about W. ½ N. and E. by N.

findlay1879.name: Hurst Beach
findlay1879.character: Two bright fixed lights (Low lt. in New Fort)
findlay1879.description: In one N.E. by E. ½ E., 670 feet apart. Another light in the lighthouse shows only up the Solent

findlay1887.name: Hurst Beach
findlay1887.description: White towers, 85 and 52 ft. high, 223 yards apart N.E. by E. ¼ E., in rear of fortifications. High light visible between S.W. ¾ W. and W. by S. ¾ S., low light between S.W. and W. by S. ½ S. Leading light shown from high lt.-ho. up the Solent, betw. E. & E. by N. ½ N.

findlay1879.name: Needles Outer Rock
findlay1879.character: One fixed bright, or red light
findlay1879.description: Shows red to S. from S.E. ½ S. to W.; then bright over entrance of Needles Channel to W.N.W.; thence red up the ch[?]nnel to N.E. by E., and then bright to N.E. by E. ½ E., to clear Warden Ledge. A bell in fogs

findlay1887.name: NEEDLES OUTER ROCK
findlay1887.character: One occulting bright, red, or green light, ½ minute
findlay1887.description: Granite tower, 109 feet high, white with one black band. Light eclipsed 3 secs. every ½ min., shows red to South from S.E. ¾ S. to W. ¾ S.; thence bright over entrance of Needles Channel to W. by N. ¾ N.; thence red up the Channel to N.E. ½ E.; thence bright to N.E. by E., to clear Warden Ledge; and green thence to the land

edwards1884.name: Needles Rock, Isle of Wight
edwards1884.character: White, occulting, half-minute interval, with red and green sectors, red

findlay1879.name: BAHAMA BANK LT.-V.
findlay1879.description: In 11 fms., on S.W. part of bank. Powerful Fog-trumpet; Warning Gun. To be altered in May, 1879, to revolving br. lt., showing 2 flashes once in every ½ minute

findlay1887.name: BAHAMA BANK LT.-V.
findlay1887.description: In 11 fathoms, off S.E. end of bank. Light shows 2 quick flashes, followed by 20 secs. darkness. Red, with ball

name: Point of Ayre (Isle of Man)

findlay1879.name: POINT OF AYRE
findlay1879.character: A rev. lt., br. and red, alternately
findlay1879.description: A stone tower, 99 ft. high, ¼ mile S.W. of the point; flash every minute

findlay1887.name: POINT OF AYRE
findlay1887.description: White stone tower, 99 ft. high, ½ mile S.W. of the point. Light bright and red alternately

edwards1884.name: Ayre Point
edwards1884.character: White and red alternately, revolving, one minute interval

report1879: white and red alternate every min.

findlay1879.name: DOUGLAS
findlay1879.description: A brown stone tower, 65 ft., on Douglas Head; not visible from Lang Ness

findlay1887.name: DOUGLAS
findlay1887.description: White stone tower, 65 feet high, on Douglas Head. Light obscured inshore of S.W. ¼ W.

findlay1879.name: Langness Point
findlay1879.description: Light proposed

findlay1887.name: LANGNESS
findlay1887.description: Lighthouse, 63 ft. high, on S.E. part of point. Light shows a flash every 5 secs.

findlay1879.name: CHICKEN ROCK
findlay1879.description: Granite tower 143 ft. high, ¾ mile W. from S. extremity of Calf of Man. Fog-bell every ½ minute

findlay1887.name: CHICKEN ROCK
findlay1887.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
findlay1887.description: Granite tower, 143 ft. high, [?] mile West from South extremity of Calf of Man
